title: Why the Bears’ Indiana Move Isn’t Final Despite State Celebrations

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Why the Bears’ Indiana Move Isn’t Final Despite State Celebrations
sources.description: The Chicago Bears appeared to take another step toward leaving Chicago on Friday, announcing that their board of directors met and voted to advance a stadium development project in Hammond, Ind. The potential move, which does not yet have an exact site, is not final and would require NFL approval. In a statement by Bears …
